name: contentasoft-cad-converter
description: 3D CAD Converter for Windows: converting STEP, IGES, STL, OBJ, FBX, glTF, 3MF and other 3D/CAD files, on local files.

interface.longDescription: Convert CAD and 3D model files (STEP, IGES, STL, OBJ, FBX, glTF, 3MF) on your Windows PC, for 3D printing, the web or another CAD tool. 3D CAD Converter is a Windows desktop app for converting STEP, IGES, STL, OBJ, FBX, glTF, 3MF and other 3D/CAD files; this skill teaches the agent its command-line tool (cadconvert), so you ask in plain words and the work runs on your own PC, on your own files, with nothing uploaded. It needs 3D CAD Converter installed (https://www.contenta-software.com/3dcadconverter/download.php). In Codex the agent runs the commands for you; in ChatGPT it tells you which command to run. Support: bruno@contenta-software.com
defaultPrompt: Convert every STEP file in this folder to STL for 3D printing.
Turn this IGES assembly into a GLB I can view on the web.
What units and how many triangles does this OBJ have?
